source: Per-company AR extraction (Screener.in PDFs + IR sites) — Claude.ai routine, daily batch of 20

china_plus_one.evidence: Radico Khaitan is a domestic IMFL (Indian Made Foreign Liquor) company. Business is predominantly India-focused; exports to duty-free and select international markets are minimal. No China+1 supply-chain diversification narrative applicable.

rural.evidence: Radico's mass/value and prestige brands (8PM whisky, Contessa rum, Rampur single malt) serve semi-urban and value-seeking segments. Rural and semi-urban India is a key market but exact rural revenue % is not disclosed in accessible sources.

crude_exposure.evidence: ENA (Extra Neutral Alcohol), the primary raw material, is grain-based (maize, broken rice) and not directly crude-linked. Packaging materials (glass bottles, PET, aluminium caps) have indirect petrochemical exposure, but crude is not a primary cost driver.

inr_exposure.evidence: Primarily domestic business; exports are very small. Minimal USD/INR revenue exposure.

china_plus_one.evidence: Schaeffler India manufactures precision bearings and power transmission components integrated into Schaeffler AG's global supply chain. As global automotive and industrial OEMs diversify component sourcing away from China, Schaeffler India's export volumes to the parent group and third parties benefit. Explicit 'China+1' language not confirmed without AR access.

govt_capex.evidence: Schaeffler India supplies bearings to Indian Railways and industrial machinery used in government infrastructure projects (power plants, steel mills), providing indirect government capex exposure. Exact revenue % not confirmed without AR.

crude_exposure.evidence: Steel (bearing rings/rollers) is the primary raw material. Lubricants and packaging have minor petrochemical/crude linkage.

inr_exposure.evidence: Schaeffler India has significant export revenue principally to Schaeffler AG (Europe) and other global affiliates. EUR and USD are key billing currencies for exports. Exact USD revenue % not available without AR.

pli_scheme.evidence: Auto component PLI scheme potentially applicable for Schaeffler India's precision components. Beneficiary status not confirmed without AR.

china_plus_one.evidence: BEL's core mandate is defence electronics indigenization under Atmanirbhar Bharat. As India reduces import dependence for defence systems, BEL's addressable order pipeline expands (order book ₹71,650 Cr as of end-FY25). No explicit 'China+1' terminology used but defence import substitution achieves the same strategic effect — displacing foreign (including Chinese) imports with domestic manufacture.

govt_capex.evidence: BEL derives approximately 94% of revenue from Government/Defence sector. FY2024-25 total turnover ₹23,000 Cr (+16% YoY). Segment composition: Defence ~89.75% (Ministry of Defence), Non-defence civilian government (rail/metro, smart cities, space, homeland security) ~5.75%. Export ~3.87% (USD 106.17 Mn). Sources: BEL press releases and multiple news outlets covering FY25 results.

rate_sensitive.evidence: BEL is a net-cash company with minimal external borrowings. Interest rate sensitivity on the company's P&L is low.

crude_exposure.evidence: BEL's primary inputs are electronic components, sub-systems, and assemblies. No material direct crude oil exposure.

inr_exposure.evidence: Export revenue USD 106.17 Mn in FY2024-25 (+14% from USD 92.98 Mn in FY23-24), approximately 3.87% of ₹23,000 Cr total turnover. Export order book: USD 348-359 Mn. Key export destinations: France, Spain, USA, UK, Israel, Sweden, Mauritius, Armenia, Sri Lanka, Seychelles. Sources: BEL official press release and multiple verified news reports.

pli_scheme.evidence: BEL is a key beneficiary under India's Defence PLI (Production Linked Incentive) scheme for defence electronics and is an Atmanirbhar Bharat anchor company. PLI incentive revenue quantum not separately disclosed.

china_plus_one.evidence: Siemens India is primarily a domestic capital goods company supplying to Indian infrastructure and industrial customers. Not positioned as a China+1 manufacturing export hub. Note: Siemens India's fiscal year ends September 30 (FY2024-25 = Oct 2024 – Sep 2025).

govt_capex.evidence: Siemens India derives significant revenue from government capex-linked sectors: power transmission and distribution (substations, switchgear), railways (electrification, Vande Bharat train components, metro), smart city infrastructure, and industrial automation for state utilities. Exact % not confirmed without AR.

inr_exposure.evidence: Siemens India has some export revenue (engineering services and equipment exports via Siemens AG global operations) but is predominantly domestic. Exact USD revenue % not available without AR.

china_plus_one.evidence: Nippon India AMC (NAM-INDIA) is a domestic mutual fund asset manager operating exclusively in India. No export revenue or China+1 relevance.

rate_sensitive.evidence: NAM-INDIA manages significant debt fund AUM; interest rate cuts drive increased inflows to debt/liquid funds and expand fixed-income AUM and management fees. Revenue is indirectly rate-sensitive through AUM mix dynamics between equity and debt categories.

inr_exposure.evidence: 100% domestic INR revenue business. No material USD revenue or currency exposure.

china_plus_one.evidence: Eicher Motors (Royal Enfield motorcycles + VECV commercial vehicles) is primarily a domestic OEM. International sales are for brand expansion into premium motorcycle markets, not supply-chain diversification.

rural.evidence: Royal Enfield motorcycles have a significant rural and semi-urban customer base, especially for the mid-segment 350cc Bullet and Classic models. Improved rural demand and rural financing availability was cited in FY2025 context. Export unit volume approximately 107,142 units (10.6% of 1,009,899 total units sold in FY2024-25) per news coverage of annual volumes. Specific rural revenue % not disclosed.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Retail two-wheeler financing rates significantly affect demand for Royal Enfield motorcycles at the consumer level. Eicher's own balance sheet is largely debt-free, but end-demand is rate-sensitive through NBFC/bank lending rates to consumers.

crude_exposure.evidence: Steel and aluminium castings are key raw materials. Rubber (crude derivative) used in tyres and seals. Indirect crude exposure but not the primary raw material cost driver.

inr_exposure.evidence: Export unit volume ~10.6% of total units (107,142 units) in FY2024-25 per news reports. International markets include North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia-Pacific. USD revenue % not confirmed without AR.

pli_scheme.evidence: No confirmed PLI beneficiary status. Auto PLI scheme targets advanced automotive technology and EVs; current Royal Enfield ICE motorcycle lineup does not appear to qualify.

china_plus_one.evidence: Lupin positions its API Plus business and Lupin Manufacturing Solutions (LMS) CDMO platform as preferred global API partners for customers diversifying away from China. Management has cited the India CDMO market growing from USD 3.5 Bn to USD 25 Bn over the next decade, with Lupin as a key beneficiary. No single AR quote confirming specific order wins explicitly attributed to China+1, hence moderate rather than strong.

rural.evidence: Lupin has an 'extra-urban' India field force program targeting tier 2-3 cities and rural markets, adding 400-500 medical representatives annually. No specific rural revenue % is disclosed.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Net Debt/Equity approximately -0.02 as of March 2025 (net cash position). Minimal floating rate debt exposure.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Layered hedging strategy using natural hedges and forex derivatives; monitors USD-INR, EUR-INR, ZAR-INR exposures.
inr_exposure.evidence: US/North America business accounts for ~38% of global FY2025 sales (approximately USD 925 Mn); India ~34%; Other Developed Markets (Europe/Germany) ~11%; Emerging Markets ~11%; Global API ~5%. Source: Q4 FY25 results press release and multiple verified news reports.

pli_scheme.evidence: Pharmaceutical API PLI scheme is directly applicable to Lupin's API manufacturing operations. Explicit confirmation of approved beneficiary status not available in accessible sources.

china_plus_one.evidence: Divi's Laboratories is a top-5 global API manufacturer explicitly positioned as a China+1 beneficiary. Global innovator pharmaceutical and generic companies are actively qualifying Divi's as an alternative API supplier. Divi's large-scale manufacturing in India (Visakhapatnam units) serves as a direct substitute for Chinese API supply. Management has consistently highlighted this theme in investor communications and MD&A over multiple years; new customer qualifications specifically from China+1 diversification are cited.

crude_exposure.evidence: Specialty chemical solvents, reagents, and catalysts used in API synthesis have some petrochemical feedstock linkage; crude exposure is indirect and modest relative to direct raw material cost.

inr_exposure.evidence: Divi's derives approximately 85-90% of revenue from exports to US, European, and global pharma customers. USD and EUR are the primary billing currencies. Exact export % not confirmed from accessible sources.

pli_scheme.evidence: Pharmaceutical API PLI scheme directly applicable; Divi's beneficiary status and incentive quantum not confirmed from accessible sources.

china_plus_one.evidence: ABB India manufactures electrical equipment (motors, drives, switchgear, transformers) primarily for domestic industrial and infrastructure customers. Some exports to ABB group globally and regional markets. Not prominently positioned as a China+1 beneficiary.

govt_capex.evidence: ABB India derives significant revenue from government capex-linked sectors: power T&D (HV/MV switchgear, transformers for state DISCOMS), railways (traction systems, motors for Vande Bharat), metro projects, and industrial automation for government-owned utilities. Exact % not confirmed without AR.

inr_exposure.evidence: ABB India has some export revenue to ABB group globally and other regional markets. Business is predominantly domestic. Exact USD revenue % not available without AR.

china_plus_one.evidence: KSB India manufactures industrial centrifugal pumps and valves for domestic end-markets. Not positioned as a China+1 manufacturing export hub in available sources.

govt_capex.evidence: KSB India derives significant revenue from government infrastructure projects: water supply (Jal Jeevan Mission, AMRUT urban water), sewerage, irrigation, power generation (thermal/nuclear/hydro plants), oil & gas refineries (ONGC, HPCL). Government capex is a key demand driver.

crude_exposure.evidence: Steel and alloy castings are primary raw materials. No direct crude exposure.

inr_exposure.evidence: KSB India exports pumps and spares to KSB SE's global network and to neighboring markets (Middle East, South Asia). Domestic business predominates.

china_plus_one.evidence: Sun Pharma's large-scale API and formulation manufacturing network positions it as a beneficiary of pharmaceutical supply chain diversification. Management has noted opportunities as global pharma customers seek API sourcing alternatives to China. Sun's specialty pharma CDMO partnerships benefit from this trend.

inr_exposure.evidence: Sun Pharma derives approximately 68-72% of consolidated revenue from exports. US specialty pharma business (~30-32% of revenue), Emerging Markets (~20%), Europe, and ROW are key geographies. Company maintains a comprehensive forex hedging program. Exact USD revenue % not confirmed from accessible sources.

pli_scheme.evidence: Pharmaceutical API PLI scheme relevant for Sun's API manufacturing; beneficiary status not confirmed from accessible sources.

china_plus_one.evidence: D-Mart (Avenue Supermarts) is a purely domestic Indian value retail business with no manufacturing or export operations. China+1 supply chain narrative not applicable or mentioned in disclosures.

rural.evidence: D-Mart operates 415 stores across 10+ states (Maharashtra, Gujarat, Telangana, Karnataka, AP, MP, Tamil Nadu, Rajasthan, Punjab, NCR, Chhattisgarh, Daman). The company targets semi-urban and suburban locations — not classified rural. Absent from East India and deeply rural geographies. No percentage breakdown by urban/semi-urban/rural disclosed.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Avenue Supermarts carries near-zero long-term debt (debt/OPBDITA ~0.2x in FY2025, interest cover 64.7x per ICRA). Store expansion is funded primarily through internal accruals. Short-term commercial paper usage confirmed (e.g. ₹300 Cr CP at fixed 7.18% for 90 days). Exact floating rate liability % not accessible without AR.

inr_exposure.evidence: D-Mart is a domestic-only Indian retailer. All revenues are in INR. No export revenue. No USD revenue or material foreign currency risk. Total revenue FY2024-25 approximately ₹57,790 Cr. Source: multiple news and financial reports covering FY25 results.

pli_scheme.evidence: PLI scheme applies to manufacturers; D-Mart is a retailer and is not eligible.

china_plus_one.evidence: Caplin Point Laboratories is a major exporter of finished dose formulations to Latin America and Africa. As global generics buyers diversify sourcing away from Chinese manufacturers, Caplin Point's Indian and Cambodia-based manufacturing positions it as a beneficiary. US market entry (ANDA pipeline) adds another dimension. No explicit China+1 language confirmed without AR.

inr_exposure.evidence: Caplin Point derives approximately 88-93% of revenue from exports, primarily to Latin America and Africa. Revenue is predominantly USD-denominated. Exact USD revenue % not confirmed from accessible sources.

china_plus_one.evidence: Navin Fluorine International is a leading Indian fluorochemical and CRAMS/HPF player in a space where China controls approximately 70% of global supply. Global pharma and agrochemical companies are actively qualifying Navin Fluorine's CRAMS capabilities as an alternative to Chinese fluorination chemistry. Management has cited customer-specific China+1 qualification wins and growing CRAMS pipeline in investor communications consistently over multiple years.

crude_exposure.evidence: Fluorspar (calcium fluoride) is the primary raw material for HF (hydrofluoric acid) production — a minerals-based feedstock not directly crude-linked. Specialty solvents and reagents used in CRAMS have some petrochemical linkage but crude oil is not a primary cost driver.

inr_exposure.evidence: Significant export revenue from CRAMS and HPF businesses to global pharma/agrochemical companies in USD/EUR. Domestic refrigerant and industrial fluorochemicals revenue is INR-denominated. Exact export % not confirmed from accessible sources.

pli_scheme.evidence: Specialty chemicals PLI scheme potentially relevant for Navin Fluorine's fluorochemical and specialty chemical products; beneficiary status not confirmed without AR.

china_plus_one.evidence: Gabriel India manufactures shock absorbers primarily for domestic Indian auto OEMs (Hero, Honda, TVS, Tata, M&M). Business is overwhelmingly domestic OEM supply. Not positioned as a China+1 export manufacturing hub.

rural.evidence: Gabriel India is a leading supplier of shock absorbers to two-wheeler OEMs (Hero, Honda, TVS) which sell significantly to rural and semi-urban customers. As rural two-wheeler demand strengthens, Gabriel's volumes benefit. No specific rural revenue % is disclosed.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Two-wheeler and passenger vehicle retail financing rates materially affect auto OEM volumes, which in turn drive Gabriel's component demand. Gabriel is indirectly rate-sensitive through end-demand linked to consumer vehicle financing costs.

crude_exposure.evidence: Rubber compounds (petroleum derivative), hydraulic oil, and steel tubes are key materials for shock absorbers. Crude oil price movements affect raw material costs indirectly.

inr_exposure.evidence: Gabriel India primarily supplies to domestic Indian OEMs. Export revenue is minor. Predominantly INR revenue business.

china_plus_one.evidence: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC (ABSLAMC) is a domestic mutual fund asset manager. Business is 100% India-focused with no export revenue or China+1 relevance.

rate_sensitive.evidence: ABSLAMC manages debt and liquid fund AUM; when interest rates fall, inflows to debt/liquid schemes accelerate and AUM grows, directly expanding management fee revenue. Rate cut cycles are positive for AMC profitability through AUM mix shift toward fixed income.

inr_exposure.evidence: 100% domestic INR revenue business. No material USD revenue or currency exposure.

china_plus_one.evidence: Kirloskar Brothers manufactures centrifugal pumps and fluid management systems. Has international operations (SPP Pumps UK; South Africa; Middle East subsidiaries) and exports. Not specifically positioned as a China+1 beneficiary in available sources.

govt_capex.evidence: Kirloskar Brothers derives significant revenue from government infrastructure projects: Jal Jeevan Mission and AMRUT (drinking water supply, sewerage), irrigation projects, power generation (thermal/hydro/nuclear pump sets), and government-owned refinery/petrochemical projects. Government capex is a primary demand driver.

inr_exposure.evidence: Kirloskar Brothers has international subsidiaries (SPP Pumps Netherlands/UK, South Africa, Middle East). International consolidated revenue represents a meaningful portion of group revenue. Exact USD revenue % not available without AR.

china_plus_one.evidence: Indian Hotels Company (Taj, SeleQtions, Vivanta, Ginger brands) is a hospitality business. China+1 supply-chain narrative not applicable to hotel operations.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Indian Hotels has significant long-term debt from hotel property acquisitions and room additions; interest rate changes affect financing cost for expansion. Corporate travel and MICE revenue (a key segment) can also soften in high-rate economic environments.

inr_exposure.evidence: Indian Hotels operates Taj-brand properties internationally: UK (Taj 51 Buckingham Gate), USA (Taj Boston, Pierre NYC), UAE, Maldives, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Africa, Malaysia. International room revenue and F&B contributes USD/GBP revenue. Exact international revenue % not confirmed without AR.

china_plus_one.evidence: Bosch India manufactures automotive components (fuel injection systems, starter/alternators, braking systems, wipers) and exports to Bosch's global supply network. As global auto OEMs restructure supply chains away from China, Bosch India's role as an export manufacturing hub for parent/sister entities and third-party OEMs is expanding. No explicit 'China+1' language confirmed without AR.

crude_exposure.evidence: Steel, aluminium, copper, and rubber are key raw materials for Bosch's auto components. Indirect crude exposure via rubber and petrochemical-derived materials. Note: Bosch India's fiscal year ends December 31 (calendar year reporting).

inr_exposure.evidence: Bosch India has significant export revenue to Bosch AG's global network (Europe, Americas, Asia). EUR and USD are primary billing currencies for exports. Exact export % not available without AR.

pli_scheme.evidence: Auto component PLI scheme potentially applicable for Bosch India's advanced automotive technology products (EV components, ADAS). Beneficiary status not confirmed without AR.

china_plus_one.evidence: Nykaa (FSN E-Commerce Ventures) is a domestic Indian e-commerce and omnichannel retail platform for beauty, fashion, and wellness. No export revenue or China+1 supply-chain narrative applicable.

rural.evidence: Nykaa is expanding digital and physical reach into tier 2 and tier 3 cities. Current customer base is predominantly urban/metro. No specific rural revenue % is disclosed.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Nykaa's working capital financing and physical store expansion (Nykaa Beauty stores) create some interest rate sensitivity, though the company is moving toward positive free cash flow.

inr_exposure.evidence: 100% domestic INR revenue business. No material foreign currency revenue exposure.
